title: Here’s How Freaky the Universe Would Look If Light Slowed to 3 Miles Per Hour - Nautilus
author: David Nield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementPhysicsHere’s How Freaky the Universe Would Look If Light Slowed to 3 Miles Per HourEinstein’s theories in a virtual theme parkDNBy David Nield2:00 PM CDT on October 15, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleDay to day, most of us don’t give much thought to the fundamental fact of physics that light is traveling across the universe at nearly 671 million miles per hour. But a new simulator asks a fun question: How would the universe appear if light moved at a much, much slower speed?A new web project called Relativity Park from developer Dmitry Brant lets us explore a world where the speed of light is set at 3.11 miles per hour, or a brisk walking pace. At this speed, the rules set down by Einstein’s 1905 theory of special relativity start to become much more obvious, with some mind-bending and eye-popping results.In Relativity Park, light moves at a brisk walking pace.
